summary: HubSpot OAuth needs a free developer account plus an app with Auth settings (client ID/secret, scopes, redirect URL). Install via the authorization URL. Scopes interact with customer account tiers, which is the main nuance.

approval.typical_timeline: Creating the app and running OAuth: same day. Listing in the HubSpot Marketplace is optional and separately reviewed (review process not verified in this pass).
approval.notes: No approval is needed for ordinary OAuth installs into customer accounts.

steps.title: Create a HubSpot developer account and app
steps.detail: The developer account hosts your app; the app's Auth settings page holds the client ID, client secret and scope configuration.

steps.title: Configure scopes
steps.detail: Check the scopes your app needs. Scopes checked in settings are treated as required and must appear in the authorization URL's scope parameter.

steps.title: Use optional_scope for tiered features
steps.detail: If your app spans HubSpot tiers, put tier-gated scopes in optional_scope so free accounts can still install; inspect the token afterwards to see what was granted.

steps.title: Set the redirect URL
steps.detail: Must use https in production (http allowed for localhost testing); domains required, IP addresses not supported.

steps.title: Send users to the authorization URL and exchange the code
steps.detail: https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&scope=...&redirect_uri=... returns a code; exchange it with the client secret for access_token and refresh_token.

nuances: Users get an error if they install into an account that lacks access to a required scope.
Access tokens expire; the refresh token is how you renew them.
An authorization URL can target a specific account by inserting the account ID in the path.
agent_can_do: Split your scope list into required vs optional by HubSpot tier
Generate the authorization URL and token exchange/refresh code
Explain install errors caused by account-tier mismatches
human_must_do: Create the developer account and app
Store and rotate the client secret safely
